versions.content: Low Frequency Container reception This interface provide the low frequency data for the CAM message. It needs to be updated initially and afterwards when a parameter is changing within the data structure. It is important to provide this data structure BEFORE the CAM message is triggered with the call to the service interface V2xFacVdp()
